description: Replace dnsmasq-normal with Pi-Hole; add can_manage_pihole admin permission

add.description: Pi-Hole admin web UI password — used server-side for API calls; never exposed to portal admins

notes: Stop and remove the dnsmasq-normal container before restarting. Start pihole/ with 'docker compose up -d'. Restart dns-parser to pick up the new log path. Set a strong PIHOLE_WEBPASSWORD in .env before launching Pi-Hole.
